title: POST /api/v1/ota/download (request body)
description: V2 only. Starts an on-device download of the newest signed release for this model. Requires an open timer, the physical Reset-button arm (which it uses up) and station Wi-Fi with Internet access. Sent as form or JSON; the body may be empty.

release_version.description: The version the person approved. If the update site now offers a different version, the download stops with error version_changed.
